full_prompt_en: A square, naive painted landscape spreads a small settlement across an off-white, visibly worked surface. The upper half remains mostly pale, with thin gray blue and pink horizontal scumbles, tiny dark marks, and a few loose yellow accents interrupting the open space. Short upright tree shapes stand in uneven groups across the middle distance. On the left, a pair of low pale buildings with black roof areas and a few dark window marks sit beside narrow vertical trees. Near the center, another small cream building occupies the far edge of a broad dark green oval. A light diagonal causeway or path runs from the lower left across that oval toward the central building, dividing the large green area into unequal parts. The oval itself holds thin gray green scratches, yellow flecks and a few small uncertain dark shapes, all kept subordinate to its broad deep tone. Around its right edge, a pale curved strip separates the green from more scattered marks and trees. A dark isolated tree rises near the lower-left corner, while a small green-roofed building sits at the lower-right edge. Tiny dark strokes distributed over the pale ground suggest distant activity without resolving into detailed figures. The perspective feels gently elevated, allowing the eye to look down across the enclosed area while still seeing the buildings face-on. The painted surface is dry, rubbed and irregular; rough outlines sometimes break apart, and the pale ground shows through loosely applied color. Light is diffuse and nearly even, with the off-white ground providing the brightest field and the dark green oval supplying most of the contrast. There are no strong cast shadows or polished highlights. The overall composition holds a large dark central shape inside a wide pale margin, using sparse marks and uneven spacing to create a quiet, handmade landscape.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形的稚拙风景画把一片小聚落铺展在米白色、留有明显绘画痕迹的表面上。上半幅大多浅淡，细薄的灰蓝和粉色水平擦痕、微小深色笔触与几处松散黄色点缀打破了空白。短而直立的树形不均匀地成组分布在中景。左侧，两座浅色矮房带有黑色屋顶区域和几处深色窗痕，旁边立着狭长的树。靠近中央，另一座小奶油色建筑位于一大片深绿色椭圆区的远边。一条浅色斜向堤道或路径从左下穿过椭圆区伸向中央建筑，把大块绿色分成不等的部分。椭圆内部有细灰绿划痕、黄色斑点和几个不确定的深色小形体，但它们都服从这块宽大的深色调。右边缘附近，一道浅色弧带把绿色与更零散的笔痕和树分开。左下角附近长着一棵孤立的深色树，右下边缘则有一座绿顶小房。浅色地面上的细小深色笔痕暗示远处活动，却不解析为细致人物。视点略高，可以俯看围合区域，同时仍见到房屋的正面。画面表面干涩、磨擦感强且不规则；粗略轮廓时有断裂，浅底从松散施加的颜料间透出。光是漫射而近乎均匀的，米白底构成最亮的面积，深绿椭圆提供大部分反差。这里没有强烈投影或光滑高光。整体构图把一块巨大的中央深色形体置于宽阔浅色边地中，以稀疏笔痕和不均匀间距形成安静的手作风景。
style_prompt_en: The image has a rough, naive painted surface in which dry scumbles, sparse scratches and uneven outlines remain visible. A wide off-white field carries thin gray blue, pale pink and occasional yellow traces, while one or two broad deep green areas create the strongest tonal weight. Forms are reduced to short upright marks, simple blocks and irregular curves, with small details left suggestive rather than fully modeled. Color sits thinly over a worn pale ground, and gaps in the pigment become part of the texture. Diffuse light keeps the surface nearly flat; contrast comes chiefly from the placement and scale of dark areas, not from cast shadows. The space is loosely elevated and compressed, with disparate small forms distributed around larger quiet masses. The overall effect is intimate and unpolished, using deliberate sparseness and rubbed color to give the composition its character.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有粗糙、稚拙的绘画表面，干擦痕、稀疏划线和不均匀轮廓清晰可见。宽阔的米白底承载细薄灰蓝、淡粉和偶尔的黄色痕迹，一两块宽大的深绿区域形成最强明暗重量。形体被简化为短竖痕、简单块面和不规则曲线，小细节停留在暗示状态，不做完整塑形。颜色薄薄覆在磨旧的浅底上，颜料空隙也成为肌理的一部分。漫射光使表面接近平面；反差主要来自深色面积的位置和尺度，而非投影。空间松散地带有俯视感且被压缩，零散小形体分布在更大、更安静的色块周围。整体效果亲近而不精修，以有意的稀疏和擦抹色彩赋予构图特征。
theme_en: A naive painted landscape with a dark green enclosed oval, small buildings and scattered trees
theme_zh: 深绿椭圆区域、小建筑与零散树木组成的稚拙风景画
name: Rose Wylie
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
